scope: Ticket and project survey response persistence and legacy event contracts
behavior: Real token hashing and lookup, tenant-scoped SQL, locked invitation update and response insert execute against PostgreSQL.
Project responses persist project_id with null ticket_id; legacy and workflow events preserve project identity.
Ticket responses remain compatible; duplicate submissions and out-of-range ratings do not create responses.
Tenant joins suppress foreign-owned contact/client metadata.
Legacy event schemas require exactly one subject and matching negative-response number.
limits: Tests use transaction-owned schemas cloned from the migrated disposable database. The project migration is applied when absent; this does not prove the full migration chain.
Only connection/context, localization and event publication boundaries are substituted; no real event delivery is claimed.
Invitation dispatch/delivery and analytics/UI remain incomplete; the project dispatch skip remains.
This is local evidence, not native candidate CI success.
